verdict.rationale: RUN documents viewing, customizing and printing payroll and HR reports online, plus multi-company reports and workforce analytics. That covers payroll reporting in general terms, but payroll registers and gross-to-net reports are never named. The only documented export is journal entries to accounting tools or a generic output file. That is a GL accounting export, not an export of the reports themselves for analysis, so it lends only adjacent support. Missing for 10: explicit payroll register and gross-to-net report types, documented report export to CSV/Excel for analysis, independent or hands-on corroboration.
